evidence: Matches the P2P label, modifies src/node/txdownloadman_impl.cpp, and directly alters transaction download and orphan resolution logic.
rationale: Fixes an edge case in transaction relay liveness where non-witness orphan resolution requests get prematurely dropped when a parent is reconsiderable. Because txid equals wtxid for non-segwit transactions, forgetting the wtxid erroneously clears queued txid queries to peers announcing the child, leaving the child stuck in the orphanage.
